items.title: Exclusive-Exxon assessing 7 areas in Venezuela for possible energy projects, sources say
items.summary: HOUSTON/CARACAS, Nov 11 (Reuters) - A preliminary agreement between ExxonMobil, the Venezuelan government and state oil company PDVSA allows the US oil producer to evaluate seven areas for development that include undeveloped fields, mature areas and an exploration block, four people ‌close to the matter said. The sources provided details about a memorandum of understanding that Exxon and PDVSA signed on Monday in Caracas in the ‌presence of interim Venezuelan President Delcy Rodriguez.
